def smelt_line(res, center, n):
    bb = BuildingBox(width=3*n, height=3)
    c = nearest_buildable(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, bb, center)
    print(res[0], "box", c.left_top, c.right_bottom)
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        p = Position(x=c.left_top.x + 1.5 + 3*i, y=c.left_top.y + 1.5)
        move_to(p)
        d = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=p, direction=Direction.UP)
        f = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, d.position, direction=Direction.UP)
        ins = place_entity(Prototype.Inserter, position=Position(x=f.position.x, y=f.position.y-2), direction=Direction.UP)
        print(" drill", d.position, d.drop_position, "furn", f.position, "ins", ins.position, ins.pickup_position, ins.drop_position)
        out.append((d, f, ins))
    return out
